title: Waist–leukocyte interaction and elevated CRP: exploratory transport across two NHANES surveys
abstract: Adding a source-centered waist × WBC term changed transported weighted Brier loss from 0.179007 to 0.178886 (delta -0.000121; approximate joint source/target PSU bootstrap95% [-0.000326,+0.000347]). Incremental improvement was not established. A flexible additive conventional-measure model was trained on NHANES III and transported without target tuning to separately recruited 2017–2018 adults. This tests one statistical representation, not a new biomarker or causal mechanism. Previously explored public surveys are not untouched confirmation.
